def load_providers_configuration(self):
    log.debug("Loading providers configuration")
    from airflow.providers_manager import ProvidersManager
    self.restore_core_default_configuration()
    
    # This loop processes configurations for multiple providers
    for provider, config in ProvidersManager().already_initialized_provider_configs:
        for provider_section, section_content in config.items():
            section_in_current_config = self.configuration_description.get(provider_section)
            if section_in_current_config is None:
                # No existing config for section, so update with a deep copy and source info
                self.configuration_description[provider_section] = deepcopy(section_content)
                section_in_current_config = self.configuration_description[provider_section]
                section_in_current_config["source"] = f"default-{provider}"

                # Set source for options within the provider section
                for option in section_content["options"]:
                    section_in_current_config["options"][option]["source"] = f"default-{provider}"
            else:
                # Provider is trying to add to or modify a section that's already been configured
                section_source = section_in_current_config.get("source", "Airflow's core package").split("default-")[-1]
                raise AirflowConfigException(
                    "The provider {} is attempting to contribute "
                    "configuration section {} that has already been added before. "
                    "The source of it: {}. This is forbidden. A provider can only "
                    "add new sections. It cannot contribute options to existing "
                    "sections or override other provider's configuration.".format(
                        provider, provider_section, section_source
                    ), UserWarning
                )

    # After configuring, set default values
    self._default_values = create_default_config_parser(self.configuration_description)
    
    # Clean up sensitive configuration values if they are present
    try:
        del self.sensitive_config_values
    except AttributeError:
        pass

    self._providers_configuration_loaded = True
